description: Candidate Ollama models for Adiyan, ordered smallest to largest. The installer picks the largest model whose min_ram_gb fits comfortably in the machine's total RAM. 'base' is the public registry tag that gets pulled; 'name' is the final model Adiyan actually uses, built locally from 'base' with an extended context window (see context.modelfile.template).

models.name: qwen3:4b-16k
models.notes: Minimum viable - noticeably weaker coaching responses, use only when RAM is tight.

models.name: qwen3:8b-16k
models.notes: Default target - this is the model Adiyan has been built and tested against. Confirmed running comfortably on a 16GB machine.

models.name: qwen3:14b-16k
models.notes: Higher quality, for machines with RAM to spare beyond the 16GB baseline.
